messages: Mira (PM): Quick design check: pushing a compact scorecard + approval flow update for prompt-sets/evals. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/scorecard-compact Main changes: moved 'Approve All' into a kebab menu to avoid accidental mass approvals; introduced inline 'request changes' action; added compact density toggle. Thoughts before dev handoff? Olive (Design): Love moving Approve All out of primary CTAs. Can we change label to 'Approve visible' or 'Approve matching' — avoids surprise? Also the kebab has too many items, consider separating destructive actions in red. Alex (Eng): From eng POV, kebab is fine. Concern: we need analytics for Approve All so we can rollback. Also need confirmation modal if >50 items. Suggest: `if (count > 50) showConfirm()`. Sam (QA): Regression diff row hover shows 'accept/reject' inline — fine. But keyboard focus order: when user tabs from left checkbox to first action, it currently skips edit menu. Repro: tab -> space -> action not focusable. Filed #452. Kavi (Accessibility): Accessibility: color of 'Approved' badge is green but contrast is 2.8:1 against white — fails AA. Recommend darker `#0b6f3a`. Also aria-labels missing on compact toggle: use `aria-label="Toggle compact density"`. For modal confirm make sure role=dialog and focus trap. Mira (PM): Good catches. For copy, I like 'Approve visible' — more explicit. Also for confirm text: 'Approve X items? This will mark responses as accepted for evaluation; changes are reversible via history.' Keep it short. Olive (Design): Microcopy nit: 'mark responses as accepted' -> 'mark selected responses as approved' — clearer. Also add tooltip for compact toggle: 'Show more items per row'. Alex (Eng): I'll add analytics + confirm. Kavi, can you paste specific color hex and aria snippet? Kavi (Accessibility): `#0b6f3a` is good. ARIA snippet: ```html ``` Also ensure skip link to jump to scorecard table: `Skip to results` Mira (PM): Thanks — will update figma and re-upload. Plan: Alex to pick up PR after Figma update, target next sprint. @deploy-bot can you post a deploy note template when PR merges? :crossed_fingers: deploy-bot: deploy-bot: noted — will post template on merge. Sam (QA): QA will add keyboard test cases to the suite. Mira (PM): Awesome, keeping this thread open until PR merged.
